name: Tm Visualization Suite: Spatial Explorer
pitch: See where orders and activity cluster on a map, from a regional overview down to single locations.
question: Where do things happen, and where do they cluster?
useWhen: Show where things happen and how dense they are.
features: Zoom in without losing the pattern
See how a town spreads out

hero.alt: Map of delivery locations for one region as hexagonal cells, pale in the dense centre and darker toward the edges.
hero.caption: Where one region's orders come from, cell by cell

screenshots.alt: Map of another region with large hexagonal cells shaded from pale to dark by order value.
screenshots.caption: Every region can have its own coarse overview

screenshots.alt: Map of a third region with medium hexagonal cells, a few dark cells at the edge.
screenshots.caption: Compare how dense the regions are, one at a time

questions: Where do our orders come from?
Which areas order the most, and which are quiet?
How fine can I look before the pattern breaks up?
audience: Analysts and BI leads who study where customers, orders or events are located.

featureStrips.heading: Start with a regional overview
featureStrips.text: Large cells give the big picture, so you see which parts of the map carry the most value.
featureStrips.alt: Map with a few large hexagonal cells over all delivery locations, shaded from pale to dark by order value.

featureStrips.heading: Zoom in without losing the pattern
featureStrips.text: Smaller cells split the regions, so the busy areas show up inside them.
featureStrips.alt: Map of one region with medium hexagonal cells, pale in the centre and darker at the edges.

featureStrips.heading: See how a town spreads out
featureStrips.text: Fine cells show how orders spread inside a town and where the edge of the cluster falls.
featureStrips.alt: Map of one region with fine hexagonal cells forming a loose cluster around a dense centre.

featureStrips.heading: Go down to single locations
featureStrips.text: The finest setting draws nearly every delivery location, so outliers outside the cluster stand out.
featureStrips.alt: Map of one region with a dot for nearly every delivery location, dense in the middle and sparse outside.
